verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an e-commerce platform, since buyers often compare hosted and self-hosted commerce systems, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Shopify only as a hosted platform. Headless/Hydrogen gives control over the frontend only, with 'Hosting included', and nothing documents running the core Shopify backend on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
